cues.en: Now we've downloaded and sort of inspected a model from torch vision models.
cues.zh: 現在已下載並大致檢查 torchvision.models 的模型。

cues.en: Let's just discuss some of the different types of transfer learning.
cues.zh: 討論幾種不同遷移學習。

cues.en: The model we're going to be focusing on is an efficient net feature extractor.
cues.zh: 我們要專注的模型，是 EfficientNet 特徵擷取器。

cues.en: So this is what we just printed out.
cues.zh: 就是剛才印出來的。

cues.en: We've got efficient net.
cues.zh: 有 EfficientNet。

cues.en: This is from torch vision models.
cues.zh: 來自 torchvision.models。

cues.en: Efficient net B0.
cues.zh: EfficientNet-B0。

cues.en: Of course, the output will be slightly different depending on the model you have here.
cues.zh: 當然，依照這裡的模型，輸出會稍有不同。

cues.en: But the idea of a feature extractor transfer learning model is quite similar, regardless of the backbone you're using.
cues.zh: 不過，不論用哪個 backbone，特徵擷取式遷移學習模型的概念都很類似。

cues.en: That's another term here.
cues.zh: 這裡又是一個術語。

cues.en: Efficient net B0 backbone.
cues.zh: EfficientNet-B0 backbone。

cues.en: So you're going to hear quite a few different terms around transfer learning.
cues.zh: 所以會聽到不少遷移學習相關詞彙。

cues.en: They all mean different versions of the same thing.
cues.zh: 都表示同一件事的不同版本。

cues.en: So we have our overall architecture here, which is an efficient net.
cues.zh: 整體架構是 EfficientNet。

cues.en: Then we have this features section.
cues.zh: 再來是 features 部分。

cues.en: Now this extracts features from an image.
cues.zh: 從影像擷取特徵。

cues.en: Now what is a feature?
cues.zh: 什麼是特徵？

cues.en: A feature could be almost anything.
cues.zh: 幾乎任何東西都可以。

cues.en: It could be the fact that pizza is a little bit curved.
cues.zh: 可能是披薩稍微彎曲。

cues.en: In some positions it could be that steak is a little bit darker than other foods.
cues.zh: 某些位置，牛排顏色比其他食物深。

cues.en: It could be that sushi often has many small items on a plate.
cues.zh: 也可能是壽司盤上常有很多小塊食物。

cues.en: The important thing in the magic of machine learning is we don't actually tell our model what a feature is.
cues.zh: 機器學習的魔法，重要的是我們並不真的告訴模型什麼是特徵。

cues.en: It learns those features and in our case, a feature extractor.
cues.zh: 它自己學這些特徵；對特徵擷取器來說，

cues.en: We keep all of these features layers or base layers or backbone layers frozen as they've learned patterns in image net.
cues.zh: 保持這些特徵層、基底層或 backbone 層凍結，因為已在 ImageNet 學過模式。

cues.en: All we really want to change in our feature extractor model is the output.
cues.zh: 特徵擷取模型真正想改的，只有輸出。

cues.en: So an image will go through all of these layers.
cues.zh: 影像通過所有這些層。

cues.en: And then what the average pull layer here does is it turns the features our model has learned, which might be a big tensor into a single feature vector.
cues.zh: 然後 avgpool，把模型學到、可能是很大張量的特徵，轉成單一特徵向量。

cues.en: So it compresses it, it compresses all of the information that our base layers, our feature layers have extracted from the image into one single vector.
cues.zh: 所以壓縮它，把基底層、特徵層從影像擷取的所有資訊，壓縮成單一向量。

cues.en: And in this case, for efficient net B0, the vector will be of size 1280.
cues.zh: EfficientNet-B0 的向量大小是 1280。

cues.en: So that's an important thing to take note is the size of the input to the last layer 1289 features and the output.
cues.zh: 所以要注意，最後一層的輸入大小，in_features 是 1280，還有輸出。

cues.en: So features is going to turn an image into a big features matrix.
cues.zh: features 把影像轉成大型特徵矩陣。

cues.en: Average pool is going to compress that or tensor is going to compress that features tensor into a single vector.
cues.zh: avgpool 把它壓縮，或者說把特徵張量壓縮成單一向量。

cues.en: And then this classifier layer or the classification head, we can adjust this to our own problem and change the number of out features.
cues.zh: 然後 classifier 層，或者分類頭，能針對自己的問題調整，改變 out_features 數量。

cues.en: In this case, efficient net B0 has 1000 LB features, but that's because it's been pre-trained on image net.
cues.zh: 這裡 EfficientNet-B0 的 out_features 是 1000，因為已在 ImageNet 預訓練。

cues.en: So we can change this to.
cues.zh: 所以能改成，

cues.en: Three for pizza, steak and sushi.
cues.zh: 3，對應披薩、牛排、壽司。

cues.en: So if we keep going, let's have a look at the original model.
cues.zh: 繼續，看看原始模型。

cues.en: So the original model that you would find on television models versus a feature extraction model.
cues.zh: 也就是 torchvision.models 裡的原始模型，對比特徵擷取模型。

cues.en: So there we have the original model.
cues.zh: 這是原始模型。

cues.en: We start with a large data set.
cues.zh: 從大型資料集開始。

cues.en: We have a number of different layers here, and the number here is quite arbitrary because it will really depend on the architecture you use.
cues.zh: 有一些不同層，這裡層數只是示意，實際取決於架構。

cues.en: I think efficient net B zero has something like 200 layers, but you can correct me if I'm wrong, then we have an output layer with the shape of a thousand for image nets, 1000 classes.
cues.zh: 我想 EfficientNet-B0 大約有 200 層，不過有錯歡迎糾正；再有大小 1000 的輸出層，對應 ImageNet 的 1000 類。

cues.en: So we use a working architecture such as a fishing net, to create the original model.
cues.zh: 用有效架構，例如 EfficientNet，建立原始模型。

cues.en: And then for feature extraction transfer learning, we're going to keep all of the base layers here frozen.
cues.zh: 特徵擷取式遷移學習，則保持這裡所有基底層凍結。

cues.en: That's a terminology you'll hear in machine learning quite often is with the base layers stay frozen.
cues.zh: 這是機器學習常聽到的術語，基底層保持凍結。

cues.en: This means they don't get updated, their parameters don't get updated during training.
cues.zh: 意思是不更新，訓練時不更新它們的參數。

cues.en: They've already been learned on Image Net.
cues.zh: 已經在 ImageNet 學過。

cues.en: So the original model layers don't update during training.
cues.zh: 所以原模型這些層，在訓練時不更新。

cues.en: So then we create a feature extraction model and we change the input data and the output head.
cues.zh: 建立特徵擷取模型時，更換輸入資料與輸出頭。

cues.en: We keep this the same.
cues.zh: 這裡保持相同，

cues.en: These feature layers.
cues.zh: 這些特徵層。

cues.en: So now the input data to our feature extraction model is going to be our own custom data set.
cues.zh: 現在，特徵擷取模型的輸入資料，是自己的自訂資料集。

cues.en: Three classes of food, pizza, steak and sushi in our case.
cues.zh: 這裡是三種食物，披薩、牛排、壽司。

cues.en: And then we change the output head so the output layer gets trained on new data.
cues.zh: 然後更換輸出頭，所以輸出層會在新資料上訓練。

cues.en: So this is the only trainable section of this whole feature extraction model.
cues.zh: 這是整個特徵擷取模型，唯一可訓練的部分。

cues.en: We're going to see this in code in a minute.
cues.zh: 等一下會看程式。

cues.en: I just want to talk about this from a conceptual overview.
cues.zh: 先從概念概述。

cues.en: So the original model, then we move to feature extraction.
cues.zh: 原始模型，再走向特徵擷取。

cues.en: Now this we could change this to be ten.
cues.zh: 如果有 10 類食物，這裡能改成 10。

cues.en: If we had ten classes of food, we could change it to 100 if we had 100 classes of food.
cues.zh: 有 100 類食物，就能改成 100。

cues.en: The point being is that the base layers, the feature extraction layers, stay frozen and that we customize the input data and the output data.
cues.zh: 重點是，基底層，也就是特徵擷取層，維持凍結，自訂的是輸入與輸出資料。

cues.en: So that's the power of transfer learning.
cues.zh: 這就是遷移學習的力量。

cues.en: And there's one more type.
cues.zh: 還有一種類型。

cues.en: So we've discussed the original model.
cues.zh: 討論過原始模型。

cues.en: Then we move on to feature extraction transfer learning where we keep the base layers frozen.
cues.zh: 再進入基底層凍結的特徵擷取式遷移學習。

cues.en: Then the final form is fine tuning.
cues.zh: 最後一種，是微調。

cues.en: Now fine tuning is best suited when you have large amounts of training data.
cues.zh: 微調最適合大量訓練資料。

cues.en: In our case, we don't necessarily have that much data.
cues.zh: 我們的例子，不一定有那麼多資料。

cues.en: We only have about 100 or so images of pizza, steak and sushi.
cues.zh: 只有約 100 張左右的披薩、牛排、壽司影像。

cues.en: But if you had a thousand images of each different class you had, you might want to look into fine tuning.
cues.zh: 不過，如果每個不同類別有 1000 張，可能就想看看微調。

cues.en: So with feature extraction, we only changed the base data set and the output layer.
cues.zh: 特徵擷取只改資料集與輸出層。

cues.en: But with fine tuning, we can unfreeze some of the base layers and update their weight to suit our custom data.
cues.zh: 微調則能解凍部分基底層，更新權重，符合自訂資料。

cues.en: And now this usually works best with large amounts of data.
cues.zh: 通常在大量資料上最有效。

cues.en: Otherwise, it's best to just keep the base layers frozen and do feature extraction.
cues.zh: 否則，最好保留基底層凍結，只做特徵擷取。

cues.en: And this order is also important.
cues.zh: 順序也很重要。

cues.en: Usually start with an original model, then move to feature extraction, transfer learning, update
cues.zh: 通常先從原始模型開始，進行特徵擷取式遷移學習，更新

cues.en: the base data set and the output head, and then slowly unfreeze layer by layer from the top down.
cues.zh: 資料集與輸出頭，然後從上往下，逐層慢慢解凍。

cues.en: When you want to fine tune your model.
cues.zh: 想微調時就這麼做。

cues.en: So we're focusing on feature extraction.
cues.zh: 我們專注特徵擷取。

cues.en: We're going to see that in a second.
cues.zh: 等一下就會看。

cues.en: And if you want to tabulated version, we're not going to spend too much time on the tabulated version because it's what we've just discussed.
cues.zh: 想要表格版本，這裡不花太多時間，因為都是剛才討論的。

cues.en: But this is just for reference later on, if you'd like to inspect that we have different kinds of trends for learning.
cues.zh: 不過可以留作之後參考，想檢查時，有不同類型的遷移學習。

cues.en: We can have the original model unchanged.
cues.zh: 原始模型可以不變。

cues.en: That is, if you have the exact kind of data the original model was trained on.
cues.zh: 如果資料種類，恰好和原模型訓練資料一樣。

cues.en: We have feature extraction, which is very helpful.
cues.zh: 還有特徵擷取，很有幫助，

cues.en: If you have a small amount of custom data like we do.
cues.zh: 如果像我們一樣，只有少量自訂資料。

cues.en: And then finally you have fine tuning, which is helpful if you have a large amount of custom data.
cues.zh: 最後是微調，有大量自訂資料時很有幫助。

cues.en: But the order of this is also important.
cues.zh: 不過順序也很重要。

cues.en: You start with an original based model, also called a foundation model.
cues.zh: 先從原始基底模型，也叫基礎模型開始。

cues.en: You would feature, extract and train the last output layer to suit your own custom data and then slowly fine tune it by unfreezing the base layers.
cues.zh: 做特徵擷取，訓練最後輸出層，符合自己的資料，再慢慢解凍基底層進行微調。

cues.en: So let's go see feature extraction, transfer, learning and action.
cues.zh: 來看特徵擷取式遷移學習的實際操作。

cues.en: We first have to prepare our original model to be able to be used for feature extraction.
cues.zh: 首先必須準備原始模型，讓它能用於特徵擷取。

cues.zh: 下支影片來做。

cues.zh: 到時見。
